Results.ReviewText:
This grill has been great to use. It cleans up easily, handles heat well and still looks brand new. Over time (it has been a couple of years), the triangular flare up plates and some of the burners have burnt through. I contacted customer service about it. They quickly had me take some photos to show the issue and supply a little additional information, then they sent out the replacement parts. They were easy to install and I have a new grill again.
I'm recommending Weber gas grills to friends. They're holding up MUCH better than the other brands I've used in the past. There is NO visible wear on the main body of the grill. Some of my previous brands started to rust through within a year of purchase. Well worth the investment.
I also like that they have this model without the burner on the side. We never use that burner and it just makes it more difficult to put a cover over the grill! BTW, the Weber covers are great too! No cracking or tearing even after a couple of years.
Results.Title: Great Grill & Outstanding Customer Service!

Results.ReviewText: My Spirit E-310 gas grill has been a joy to cook on. It provides a very even, well controlled heat. I particularly like the arrangement of the burners. Being left to right, it's easy to do indirect grilling or provide a cool zone without having to reach over a hot section. One of my "tests" for a grill is lechon asado made with a pork butt. Ours came out perfectly, with even cooking throughout and moist, tender pork. I looked at this model on a recommendation from a friend and I would not hesitate to recommend it.

Results.ReviewText: It's a great grill if you don't need all the bells and whistles with simple cleaning and is holding up well. The grease drip system is well designed and makes cleaning easier. I wanted stainless steel cooking surface but couldn't find one within my budget. The size is perfect for our small family of 3. I use it for everyday meal cooking to cut down on the mess in the kitchen. I'm still working on the temperature ranges for grilling different meats. I was worried about the porcelain-coated grates rusting but so far so good. I use a grill stone to clean them before cooking and it works well. There is some rusting on the edges of the flame covers. Not sure why bc they are coated as well. I'm not sure if it is safe to use steel wool or a grill stone on them. We just bought the cover but the stainless steel is holding up well. Took us a little while to figure out the scale system for the propane tank so read the manual. It helps if you have never had one like it.

Results.ReviewText: It seemed great at first.  It is fairly easy to clean the box but keeping the back across-the-grill ignition pipe clean is much more difficult. You have to take the gas manifold off and disconnect the burners. I would prefer a spark ignition at each burner which my older (and much cheaper) grill had.  do not like the small castor wheels. I would prefer the larger wheels of the open model but I wanted a closed cabinet so my dog could not get in and lick grease drippings. The regulator went out after 15 months. I have never had a regulator go bad before. It was replaced under warranty and the new one is fine so far. Not sure I would purchase it again.
Results.Title: My Spirit E-310 Propane Gas Grill

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
